ItemID: unavailable; Title: If I'm Honest; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in 747 and Golden makes this worth considering, but I would choose gentler vocals this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 19; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Expressive vocal music appeals to me, though I am leaning toward classical crossover right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: World From the Side of the Moon; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This is a weaker match for the relaxing classical and orchestral vocal music I currently want.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Dream With Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its classical crossover sound fits my interest in Stages and the sweeping vocals of A Musical Affair.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Perfect Gift; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It connects with my interest in seasonal vocal music, but I am not choosing a holiday album this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: It's the Girls!; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar songs and polished vocals sound appealing, but other options fit my current listening mood more closely.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: I Dreamed A Dream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The ballads and musical theatre connection suit what I enjoyed seeking out in Stages.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Red; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for a calmer orchestral or vocal album rather than a more pop-oriented listen.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Something Beautiful; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little evidence that it matches my preferred sound, so I would pass.
